description_expanded: Casa Indigo – Your Dream Coastal Getaway in Panama City Beach! Property Overview: Step into Casa Indigo, where the sun meets the sea and relaxation is effortless. This beautiful three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath vacation home comfortably hosts up to eight guests, offering the perfect escape for families and friends. From its coastal-inspired décor to its airy, light-filled spaces, Casa Indigo is designed to give you the ultimate Panama City Beach experience with every comfort of home. Living Spaces: Unwind in the spacious living room, featuring plush seating with two oversized sofas and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights after a day of beach fun. The well-appointed kitchen is ready for every culinary adventure, whether you’re whipping up a casual beachside picnic or preparing a delicious family feast. Enjoy your meals or game nights at the dining table, or pull up a seat at the breakfast bar for casual dining. For a tranquil start or end to your day, retreat to the relaxing front porch, where you can sip your favorite beverage while soaking in stunning sunset views. Bedrooms: Master Suite: Drift into restful sleep in the master suite’s king-sized bed, complemented by a flat-screen TV and a private en suite bathroom for your ultimate convenience. Guest Suite 1: Another luxurious king-sized bed awaits in the first guest suite, complete with a flat-screen TV for your entertainment. Guest Suite 2: Perfect for additional guests or kids, this room features two cozy double beds, an oversized chaise lounge, and soft, inviting bedding. The home also includes a full-sized washer and dryer, ensuring your beachwear stays fresh for the next adventure! Parking: Casa Indigo offers private parking with the added bonus of a Level 2 EV charger onsite, making it easy to keep your vehicle charged and ready for local explorations. Dog-Friendly Home: Casa Indigo welcomes your furry family members with open arms! Up to two dogs can join the vacation fun, creating unforgettable memories together. We maintain the highest standards of comfort and cleanliness, so a non refundable pet fee of $300 applies to help ensure all future guests enjoy a pristine home. A dog crate is also provided to give your furry friends a comfortable space that is designated just for them while the family is out enjoying the sunshine. There's a dog friendly beach located on the west side of Pier Park if they want to join in the family fun at the beach. We can’t wait to welcome you and your pups! Local Attractions: Located just minutes from the sugar-white sands and vibrant local attractions of Panama City Beach, Casa Indigo places you in the heart of it all. Whether you’re soaking in the sun at the beach, shopping and dining at Pier Park, or enjoying fresh seafood at local favorites like Back Beach Barbecue, Salty Sue’s Restaurant, and Mike’s Cafe and Oyster Bar, adventure is never far from home. House Rules: To ensure every guest has a peaceful stay, Casa Indigo has a few simple guidelines: No parties or large events, including bachelor or bachelorette parties. All guests under 25 must be accompanied by an adult. This is a strictly no-smoking home—violators will be asked to leave immediately.
